title: Inter-VLAN Routing Fails After Redistribution
symptoms: VLAN 10 and VLAN 20 can each reach the internet, but not each other
The core switch has static routes pointing to the router
The router has routes to both VLANs via the core switch
rootCause: The static route on the router for VLAN 20 points to the wrong next-hop interface. The route exists but forwards traffic to an unreachable or incorrect destination, creating an asymmetric path that drops return traffic.

steps.prompt: Which command shows the routing table and the static routes?
steps.hint: Look for 'S' entries - check the next-hop IP for each.

steps.prompt: Which command shows only the static routes in the configuration?
steps.hint: Compare next-hop IPs against the actual interface addresses.

steps.prompt: Which command tests reachability to the VLAN 20 gateway from the router?
steps.hint: If this fails, the static route's next-hop is unreachable.
